description: This file defines the SavingsAccountChargePaidBy class, which models the association between a savings account transaction and a charge paid within the account. It includes fields for transaction, charge, and amount, along with methods to access and modify these fields, as well as logic to determine charge types and rule override permissions.

classes.name: SavingsAccountChargePaidBy
classes.description: Entity representing a record of a charge paid by a savings account transaction, including associations to the transaction and the charge, as well as the amount paid.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of SavingsAccountChargePaidBy with specified transaction, charge, and amount.

methods.name: getSavingsAccountTransaction
methods.description: Returns the associated savings account transaction.

methods.name: setSavingsAccountTransaction
methods.description: Sets the associated savings account transaction.

methods.name: getSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Returns the associated savings account charge.

methods.name: setSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Sets the associated savings account charge.

methods.name: isFeeCharge
methods.description: Determines whether the associated charge is a fee.

methods.name: isPenaltyCharge
methods.description: Determines whether the associated charge is a penalty.

methods.name: canOverriteSavingAccountRules
methods.description: Checks if the rules for the savings account can be overridden for this charge.
